title: Quasipolynomial trace samples for arbitrary symbols
exact_target: At retention probability $p\in (0,1]$, can every length-n string of exactly observed symbols be reconstructed with constant success using $\exp (O(p^{-1}(\log $ $n)^{3}(1+\log $ $\log (2n))^{6}))$ ordinary deletion traces, with an absolute implied constant and no computational-time assertion?
